primary_source: Muhurta Chintamani, supplemented by Dharma Sindhu, Nirnaya Sindhu, Narada Samhita and Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra

cycle.note: fertile_window offsets are days relative to the estimated ovulation day (cycle_day − ovulation_day). Anything earlier than the earliest listed band and still inside the Ritukala is 'pre_fertile'; anything later is 'luteal'; past the sixteenth night from the onset of menses it is 'beyond_ritukala'.

scan.note: The requirement is a fixed 45-day horizon, so the scan crosses into the next cycle. cycleModel() projects forward by whole cycle lengths and flags projected cycles as lower confidence.

advanced_panel.note: Decision D2 of the master plan: the couple's progeny-chart strength (5th house, 5th lord, Jupiter, Saptamsa D7, Putra-karaka) is shown in its own panel and never moves a date's score or band, so a date scores identically whether or not birth details were supplied.

disclaimers.medical: This module is not medical advice. The fertile window is a calendar estimate; consult a qualified physician for anything concerning conception or fertility.
disclaimers.pcpndt: In compliance with the PCPNDT Act, 1994, this tool does not implement, display or support any rule concerning the sex of the offspring.
disclaimers.approximation: Eclipse detection is approximate — it is derived from the Sun's distance from the lunar node at syzygy and does not account for visibility from your location. Verify against a published panchanga before relying on it.
